name: Tengoku Palace and Kinshi, the forbidden city
description: From the golden gates of Yamanoma, a path leads to the Tengoku Palace, where the relics of the gods are hidden, along with an array of other mystical items and tameranium. The road is paved with golden tiles, adorned with arches bearing red lanterns, each marked with the emblem of Fumetsu Eido. Many guardians are on the way, some human monks and priests, others unnatural as Shisa (Lion-dog statues that come to life when intruders approach), and tameranium dragons. There is another protection on the artifacts. When close to any of them, a hundred other copies appear, and the legends say the guidance for the correct one comes from the pure heart. If the wrong one is taken, a Spirit Guardian possesses one of the samurai statues and attacks the robbers. There are only three objects that can reveal the correct artifact: the Jade Dragon Statuettes.
